entity: Groupon Shared Services Poland Sp. z o.o.
summary: 20 or 26 days depending on total working seniority — which counts years of education, not tenure at Groupon; 4 on-demand days; carry-over to 30 September.

owner.role: Employment counsel (PL) + Shared Services HR lead

locationAssumption.citation: Employees of the shared-services entity assumed to be in Poland (national holidays only)

rule.citation: Kodeks pracy art. 154² §1–2: leave is granted in hours of the employee's daily working time, one leave day = 8 hours — a part-timer on 4-hour days uses ½ leave-day per day off; holidays are not counted
rule.note: Art. 154² §4: a part-day may be granted only when the remaining balance is less than a full working day.

source.citation: Ustawa o dniach wolnych od pracy (tekst jednolity Dz.U. 2025 poz. 296), incl. 24 December from 2025 (Dz.U. 2024 poz. 1965) — 14 days incl. 2 Sundays

rule.citation: Kodeks pracy art. 130 §2: a holiday falling on a day other than Sunday reduces working time by 8h — employer must designate another day off
Kodeks pracy art. 154 §1 (20 days < 10 years, 26 days ≥ 10 years) and art. 155 §1 (education periods count toward seniority; only the highest qualification counts)
rule.note: Checked against Kodeks pracy (Dz.U. 2026 poz. 1245). Art. 155 §2: where study and employment overlap, count whichever is more favourable, not both — priorServiceYears must exclude work that overlapped with study. Since 2026, art. 302¹ also counts civil-law contracts, self-employment and some foreign work once documented (see extra rule).

rule.citation: Kodeks pracy art. 153 §1 (first job: 1/12 on completing each month of work), art. 155¹ §1 (proportional in the year of joining or leaving), art. 155²a §2 (an incomplete month rounds up), art. 155³ §1 (an incomplete day rounds up)
Kodeks pracy art. 168: leave not taken in its year must be granted by 30 September of the following year (except the on-demand part); the claim itself only expires after 3 years (art. 291 §1)
rule.note: The engine never lapses Polish leave; it raises an HR task after 30 September.

rule.citation: Kodeks pracy art. 165–166: leave is postponed/interrupted by temporary incapacity
Kodeks pracy art. 171: ekwiwalent only on termination
rule.note: Art. 171 §3: no payout if the employee is rehired directly under a new contract with the same employer.

extras.label: Leave on demand
extras.citation: Kodeks pracy art. 167²: up to 4 days per year on demand, within the annual entitlement
extras.note: Four of the employee's own days, also for part-timers; the cap applies across employers in the year (art. 167³).

extras.label: Part-time
extras.citation: Kodeks pracy art. 154 §2: part-time entitlement is proportional to FTE, rounded up to a full day

extras.label: Top-up on reaching 10 years
extras.citation: Kodeks pracy art. 158: an employee who reaches the higher entitlement during the year gets the difference (urlop uzupełniający) in that year

extras.label: What counts as seniority from 2026
extras.citation: Kodeks pracy art. 302¹ (Dz.U. 2025 poz. 1423): periods under civil-law contracts, self-employment and some work abroad count toward seniority (private employers from 1 May 2026), once the employee documents them within 24 months; overlapping periods count once
extras.note: Include these periods in priorServiceYears. The biggest 2026 change to Polish leave.
